properties.name: release_modifier
properties.comment: The modifier whose release chooses the current row, as releasing Ctrl ends Ctrl+Tab; none (the default) leaves choosing to Enter or a click. Anything but none, control, alt or meta throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.
prepare: const bool accepted = incoming == Modifier::none || incoming == Modifier::control ||
if (!accepted) throw std::invalid_argument("DockNavigator release modifier must be one of control, alt and meta");
